verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a payments SaaS like SumUp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data residency. Offline Transactions caching card data on the device is store-and-forward behaviour, not a choice of storage region, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
